rubber-foot.label: kernel-bug:bbox-from-mesh
rubber-foot.note: volume, area and centre of mass match; body.box (mesh-derived) is 0.044 mm short of the analytic bbox on the filleted rim, over the 1e-3 diagonal tolerance. The MCP check (analytic bbox) passes.

pipe-saddle-p-clamp.label: kernel-gap:fillet-plane-cylinder-line
pipe-saddle-p-clamp.note: fillet (r 2, also 0.5 and 0.05) of the straight edge where a foot top plane meets the tube cylinder (axis parallel to the plane) is blendUnsupported; a chamfer of the same edge works.

conduit-snap-clip.label: kernel-gap:fillet-plane-cylinder-line + kernel-bug:countersink-coincident
conduit-snap-clip.note: F7 lip fillet is blendUnsupported (plane wall x bore cylinder, line edge); F15 countersink cone cut booleanFailed: the cone base circle has the radius of the drilled hole (exact coincidence on the cylinder wall; radius +-0.01 works).

conical-pour-funnel.label: kernel-bug:cut-coincident-circle-on-cylinder
conical-pour-funnel.note: F14 bore cylinder cut booleanFailed: the earlier inner-cone cut leaves a base circle exactly on the bore cylinder wall (r 4.4).

knuckle-hinge.label: kernel-bug:countersink-coincident + reference-mismatch:overlapping-solids
knuckle-hinge.note: four countersink cone cuts booleanFailed (cone base circle = hole radius 1.8). Also the example returns two leaves that overlap each other (sum of volumes 5146.71, union 4990.04, brepjs fuse); we build one body, so the volume reference is the sum and cannot be matched exactly even when the cuts work.

dovetail-joint.label: kernel-gap:body-level-intersect
dovetail-joint.note: male half matches exactly (12415.619). The female cavity is a prism minus two rotated slabs (tool = A minus B), which no sequence of add/cut features can express without first cutting the plate; translated without the taper: volume 0.18% low (-45.6 mm3).

modular-hose-segment.label: kernel-bug:sphere-pole-inside-other-solid
modular-hose-segment.note: F5 union of the truncated ball with the waist cylinder is booleanFailed; any union/cut where a sphere pole lies inside the other solid fails (cylinder ending below the pole works); later features cascade (cutNoEffect).

rubber-foot.label: kernel-bug:step-import-torus-fillet
rubber-foot.note: SHELL_ORIENTATION x2, volume 44% low (fillet torus rim from OCCT; same family as BenchCAD B3-3).

conduit-snap-clip.label: kernel-gap:step-import-hyperbola
conduit-snap-clip.note: the reference STEP carries a HYPERBOLA curve, which ck-io does not support.

rotary-potentiometer.label: kernel-gap:step-import-hyperbola
rotary-potentiometer.note: the reference STEP carries a HYPERBOLA curve, which ck-io does not support.

engine_note: examples read from the repository HEAD (brepjs 20.5.0) and run with the npm package brepjs 20.5.0 + occt-wasm 5.6.0; the deployed playground build is 20.4.0 (commit 2907fb1) and was not compared
